name: Fulgor: I Hate, Therefore I Am
storyline:
Blur the lines between ancient history and mythology in fulgor, a romance visual novel set during the Roman Republic's invasion of Etruria in 299 BC.

With Hatred dead, no one can oppose the legions of the She-Wolf; they roam the countryside, a horde of men and violence, razing any settlements they encounter and leaving no prisoners.

Only you can stop them.

Play as Thanchvil, a Rasna woman tasked by her pantheon to revive the god of Hatred.

Embark on a journey to take on a lover and slay them where divine blood still paints the waters, so that Hatred may return.
summary: Slay your lover, so that the god of Hatred may be reborn. Romance the invading soldier or the fearsome monster in this mythology-inspired visual novel set in ancient times. Will you return Hatred to your people, or will you be conquered and forgotten?
